reason: CaliPopGen CoordError quantifies uncertainty of curator-georeferenced coordinates, whereas author-reported coordinates may have missing CoordError. Missing error must not be silently imputed as measured zero.
coordinate_rule: Require finite two-endpoint lon/lat; accept non-missing CoordError <=25 km; accept missing CoordError only as 'published/unquantified' separate quality category and explicitly report its number. Exclude numeric >25 km. No inference of zero measurement error from missing.
missing_error_sensitivity: A separate strictly known-error-only count is descriptive and not an alternative confirmatory panel.
metric: Use only exact Fst metrics by deterministic F_ST/Fst normalization; no other genetic distances
study_group: CitationID × accepted Pop1ScientificName × MarkerType × GeneTarget × sepAnalyses; no mixing of different study/locus responses
eligibility: At least 5 distinct un-ordered site pairs, 4 sites, and maximum 100 km great-circle separation within each study-species-marker group; ≥30 species and ≥10 species in each hash role
before_opening: Only GenDist cell presence (not content) may be inspected. Outcomes remain sealed until calibration and climate data complete.
